subject: PO reference audit & line-item repair for LumenWorks onboarding
messages:
From: Sam Reynolds <sam@lumenworks.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Question: PO number and line items for Redwood onboarding

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding call this morning. We pulled the provisional PO reference you sent (88021) — thank you — but ran into a mismatch on our side when we tried to map the invoice. The PO in the file is a single line item labeled `Compute` which doesn't map cleanly to our ledger (we need separate lines for `Inference hours`, `Model storage`, and `Support`).

We also noticed the spend cap on the provisional PO is tied to a single aggregate value. For our finance process we need the cap allocated per line item (or at least a per-sku reference) so our invoicing workflow doesn't reject the charges. Could you advise whether you can: 1) issue a provisional PO with split line items, or 2) give us a PO reference mapping table we can attach to invoices?

I've attached our vendor onboarding worksheet (WIP) and a sample invoice that shows how our AP system expects line-level references.

Appreciate any quick help — we have an upcoming billing run next week.

Thanks,
Sam Reynolds
Vendor Operations | LumenWorks
sam@lumenworks.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachment: LumenWorks_vendor_onboarding_draft.pdf (form, 280KB)
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Sam Reynolds <sam@lumenworks.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Question: PO number and line items for Redwood onboarding

Hi Sam —

Thanks for the clear note and the sample invoice. Sorry for the friction — we typically issue provisional POs as aggregated lines for initial activation, but we can absolutely produce a split-line provisional that matches your `Inference hours` / `Model storage` / `Support` breakdown so your AP can ingest it cleanly.

Two quick requests so we do this right:
- Can you confirm the SKU names you use for `Inference hours` vs `Model storage` (just the exact strings your ledger expects)?
- Can you attach one full sample invoice from your AP system (with the rejection reason) if possible so I can share it with accounting?

I'm looping Laura and Ben on the CC — Laura will confirm the spend-cap handling and Ben can issue a provisional PO file with the split lines. Ben, can you draft the provisional PO that ties PO 88021 to per-line spend caps and return a CSV we can send to LumenWorks? Accounting will still require the W9 and final vendor code before we convert to a permanent PO.

Plan: Ben issues split provisional PO by end of day, vendor confirms W9, accounting finalizes vendor code, then we replace provisional with permanent PO number.

Best,
Priyom
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sam Reynolds <sam@lumenworks.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 14:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Question: PO number and line items for Redwood onboarding

Hi all —

Thanks — I've created a provisional PO export that splits PO 88021 into the three vendor-facing line items Sam requested. Provisional PO reference: PO-2025-88021-PR. I've attached a CSV that your AP team can map directly. Summary:

- PO-2025-88021-PR (provisional)
  - Line 1: INFERENCE-HR | qty 10000 | unit: token-hours | cap: $45,000
  - Line 2: MODEL-STORAGE | qty 1 | unit: TB/mo | cap: $5,000
  - Line 3: SUPPORT-STD | qty 1 | unit: mo | cap: $2,000

Notes/next steps:
- This is provisional: once we receive LumenWorks' W9 and vendor code is created in our ERP, accounting will issue the permanent PO number and reference mapping will carry forward.
- For now, please use PO-2025-88021-PR on all invoices to avoid rejections; include a column with `line_code` mapping (shown above) to match our internal GL.
- If you need the spend cap split expressed on your invoice line in a particular currency/format, tell me and I can change the CSV.

Attachment: provisional_po_88021.csv

Ben Carter
Vendor Programs | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Hi Priyom / Ben —

Thanks for turning this around so quickly. The CSV looks good and will flow into our AP mapping. I've attached the completed W9 and uploaded the signed vendor packet to DocuSign (link below). Thanks again — expecting the first invoice on 08/05.
